name: Glass progress bar
oneLiner: a thick glass tube fills with lit accent liquid while the camera rides its head, the percent rides inside the fill, milestone nodes light as it passes them and a check seal is pressed into the end
say: when the speaker walks through stages toward a goal ('from idea to launch in 30 days'): each milestone lights as it is named, the check lands on the word that says it is done. Set value below 100 for 'we are 70% there'. On 9:16 the bar stands as a column; as an overlay it lies flat in the upper third
